description: This file defines a Helpers class with static methods for extracting and converting data types such as booleans, strings, integers, and floats, used within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library for text data manipulation.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for type conversion and validation used in text data calculations.

methods.name: convertBooleanValue
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its string representation, handling compatibility modes (OpenOffice, etc.).

methods.name: extractString
methods.description: Extracts a string from a mixed value, converting booleans appropriately and optionally throwing errors for error values.

methods.name: extractInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer from a mixed value, enforcing minimum constraints and handling specific compatibility modes.

methods.name: extractFloat
methods.description: Extracts a float from a mixed value, converting booleans and handling null values.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates and converts a mixed value to an integer.
